title: Async Generator Pattern for Lazy Streaming
title_es: Patrón Async Generator para Streaming Perezoso
description: Stream data lazily with async generators in Python, JavaScript and Java. Yield values as they arrive for memory-efficient processing of large sequences.
description_es: Stream datos perezosamente con async generators en Python, JavaScript y Java. Procesá secuencias grandes o infinitas con uso constante de memoria.
